title: Visible but Not Avoided: State-Dependent Re-Proposal of Rejected Candidates in Catalog-Based LLM Optimization Loops
abstract: arXiv:2610.15738v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM optimization loops often show the proposer the candidates it has already tried and rejected, but leave it to the proposer to avoid them. We ask whether avoidance measured in a static probe predicts avoidance in the states an optimizer's own trajectory produces. In catalog-based loops where three open LLMs improve a GUI agent by naming one of 40 edits, a re-proposal is identified exactly by the edit's name. Clean base-state probes underpredict re-proposal in the proposers' own loops (macro-averaged loop-minus-probe rate 0.32 [0.27, 0.37]), and proposals of already evaluated harness-edit pairs consume 28-63% of valid proposer iterations. The two settings reject different edits: a probe's rejected edits are mostly ones the proposer did not choose, whereas a loop's are its own earlier choices, which remain preferred when the history is removed. translated_title: 可见但未被规避：基于目录的LLM优化循环中被拒绝候选方案的状态依赖性重新提议
translated_abstract: LLM优化循环通常会将提议者此前已尝试并被拒绝的候选方案展示给提议者，但规避这些方案的任务则完全留给提议者自己。我们探究的问题是：在静态探针中测得的规避能力，能否预测优化器自身轨迹所产生状态中的规避行为。在基于目录的循环中，三个开源LLM通过从40种编辑中指定一种来改进GUI智能体，重新提议可以通过编辑的名称被精确识别。在干净的基础状态下进行的探针测试会低估提议者自身循环中的重新提议率（宏平均的“循环减探针”比率为0.32 [0.27, 0.37]），而对已被评估过的框架-编辑对的重新提议消耗了有效提议者迭代的28-63%。两种设置所拒绝的编辑并不相同：探针中拒绝的编辑大多是提议者原本未选择的，而循环中拒绝的则是提议者自身早先的选择——即使移除历史记录，这些选择依然被偏好。普通的历史记录会降低两名提议者的重新提议率，但会提高第三名提议者的重新提议率，且这一效……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现，干净基础状态下的静态探针测试会显著低估LLM优化循环中已被拒绝候选方案被重新提议的真实发生率（宏平均差异达0.32），且提议者尤其倾向于重新提议自己早先的选择，表明规避行为是状态依赖的，无法通过静态评估来预测。
en_tdlr: Static base-state probes underpredict re-proposal of rejected candidates in LLM optimization loops (macro-averaged loop-minus-probe rate 0.32), revealing that avoidance behavior is state-dependent—proposers preferentially re-propose their own earlier choices—so clean-state evaluation fails to predict in-loop avoidance.
